import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SP="MVDCQKEACNLQSCIQRNQYNQGNCEKFVNDLLLCCKRWYDKNSLTGNEAPHTCPELKPLLRQLSSRNLT"
HS="MPQKDPCQKQACEIQKCLQANSYMESKCQAVIQELRKCCAQYPKGRSVVCSGFEKEEEENLTRKSASK"
SC="MSNPCQKEACAIQDCLLSHQYDDAKCAKVIDQLYICCSKFYNDNGKDSRSPCCPLPSLLELKMKQRKLTPGDS"

# gapless identity anchored on the cysteine offset (+3), over the CHCH core Cys1..Cys6
def gapless_id(a,b,off,lo,hi):
    m=t=0
    for i in range(lo,hi+1):
        j=i+off
        if 1<=j<=len(b): t+=1; m+= (a[i-1]==b[j-1])
    return m,t
m,t=gapless_id(SP,HS,3,4,36)
print(f"cmc4 vs human CMC4, gapless at the cysteine-anchored offset +3, core C1..C6 (Sp 4-36):")
print(f"  identity {m}/{t} = {100*m/t:.1f}%")
m2,t2=gapless_id(SP,SC,1,4,36)
print(f"cmc4 vs S. cerevisiae Cmc4, offset +1, Sp 4-36: identity {m2}/{t2} = {100*m2/t2:.1f}%")
print("\nNOTE: the earlier full-length Needleman-Wunsch run in this session produced a pathological")
print("alignment (scattered single gaps, 2/7 Cys aligned) and was discarded as a code defect.")
print("Identity is therefore reported only over the cysteine-anchored core, where the register is")
print("unambiguous, and should be treated as approximate.\n")

print("Inter-cysteine spacing across 700 My:")
cys=lambda s:[i+1 for i,a in enumerate(s) if a=="C"]
for nm,s in [("S. pombe cmc4",SP),("H. sapiens CMC4",HS),("S. cerevisiae Cmc4",SC)]:
    c=cys(s); g=[c[i+1]-c[i] for i in range(len(c)-1)]
    print(f"  {nm:<20} Cys {c}\n{'':22}gaps {g}")
print("\n  -> the first five gaps (5, 5, 11, 10, 1) are identical in all three.")
print("     Consensus core: C-x4-C-x4-C-x10-C-x9-C-C")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.2))
cols=["#b2182b","#4393c3","#999999"]

      "Disulfide-relay CHCH protein\n(import route / localisation)":("SUPPORTED",0.85,1),
